(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let ((mode-block (lambda (r1 c1)
                               (let ((freq (make-hash))
                                     (best 0)
                                     (best-count -1))
                                 (for* ((r (range r1 (+ r1 3))) (c (range c1 (+ c1 2))))
                                       (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                         (when
                                           (!= v 0)
                                           (hash-set! freq v (+ 1 (hash-ref freq v 0))))))
                                 (hash-for-each freq
                                                (lambda (k v)
                                                  (when
                                                    (> v best-count)
                                                    (set! best k)
                                                    (set! best-count v))))
                                 best))))
             (build-grid 4
                         5
                         (r c)
                         (cond
                           ((or (zero? r) (= r 3) (zero? c) (= c 4)) 0)
                           (else (let* ((br (- r 1))
                                        (bc (- c 1))
                                        (block-r1 (+ 1 (* br 4)))
                                        (block-c1 (+ 1 (* bc 3))))
                                   (mode-block block-r1 block-c1)))))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (mode-block r1 c1)
       (let ((freq (make-hash))
             (best 0)
             (best-count -1))
         (for* ((r (range r1 (+ r1 3)))
                (c (range c1 (+ c1 2))))
           (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
             (when (not (= v 0))
               (hash-set! freq v (+ 1 (hash-ref freq v 0))))))
         (hash-for-each freq
           (lambda (k v)
             (when (> v best-count)
               (set! best k)
               (set! best-count v))))
         best))
     (define modes
       (for*/list ((br (range 0 2))
                   (bc (range 0 3)))
         (mode-block (+ 1 (* br 4)) (+ 1 (* bc 3)))))
     (define (frequency value)
       (length (filter (lambda (item) (= item value)) modes)))
     (define target
       (first (filter (lambda (value) (= (frequency value) 2)) modes)))
     (define positions
       (for*/list ((br (range 0 2))
                   (bc (range 0 3))
                   #:when (= (list-ref modes (+ (* br 3) bc)) target))
         (list br bc)))
     (define r0 (apply min (map first positions)))
     (define r1 (apply max (map first positions)))
     (define c0 (apply min (map second positions)))
     (define c1 (apply max (map second positions)))
     (grid-from-fn 4 5
       (lambda (r c)
         (cond
           ((or (= r 0) (= r 3) (= c 0) (= c 4)) 0)
           ((and (<= r0 (- r 1)) (<= (- r 1) r1)
                 (<= c0 (- c 1)) (<= (- c 1) c1)) target)
           (else 0)))))))
